description:

author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Rockstar Games and Netflix are partnering for an extended look at Grand Theft Auto 6. The special will air on Thursday, August 27th at 12pm Pacific on the streaming service, followed by a debut on YouTube six hours later. In other news, an advisory sticker has been spotted on PlayStation 5 console boxes, warning consumers that Sony will eventually stop selling games on physical media. Despite immense pushback from diehard fans, Sony doesn't seem to be changing course on their plan for an all-digital future. And in related news, Capcom doesn't seem to be worried about physical media dying out. The developer/publisher reports that around 90% of its game sales come from digital, so their business will likely not be drastically affected by the end of games on disc.

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAuto6 #Gaming
title: GTA 6 to Premiere Extended Look on Netflix - IGN Daily Fix

description:
Quake: Dawn of the Machine is available now as a free update. Watch the Quake: Dawn of the Machine launch trailer to see what to expect with this new episode for the FPS. Quake: Dawn of the Machine features 19 new maps and new enemy and weapon variants.

To celebrate Quake’s 30th anniversary, the award-winning team at MachineGames—in collaboration with id Software—returns with Dawn of the Machine, a brutal new episode building on their critically acclaimed work on Dimension of the Machine and Dimension of the Past. 

End the nightmare. Escape the Illusion. 

Ranger is trapped in a dimension of endless illusion, reliving the same violent cycles for what feels like lifetimes, dying thousands of times in a futile attempt to escape. Wearied but unbroken, he has heard rumor of The Nightmare Machine.   

Beyond the hordes of monsters, twisted by an eternity in the Elder realms, lies the Machine. It is believed its destruction will shatter the illusion, finally breaking the loop.

#QuakeDawn

Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 drops up to four players into the boots of Colonial Marines deployed to the most hostile corners of the Alien universe. Inspired by the life of a beloved American icon, Madden chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis – from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game. Madden is the celebration of a brilliant mind whose once-in-a-century spirit and personality, partnership with his daring wife Virginia, lifelong friendships, and infectious love of people and football transcended the world of sports. 

Madden stars Nicolas Cage, Christian Bale, Kathryn Hahn, Matt Medrano, Sienna Miller, and more. The film is directed by David O. Russell and written by David O. Russell and Cambron Clark.
